name: postez
description: Generate TypeScript interfaces and enums from PostgreSQL database schemas with custom type mappings

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && tsc && bun run build:cli && cp -R sql dist/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format cjs --external pg-promise --external prettier --external fs --external path --external os
scripts.publish:patch: bun run build && npm version patch && npm publish
scripts.publish:minor: bun run build && npm version minor && npm publish
scripts.publish:major: bun run build && npm version major && npm publish

author: Daniel Ivanov
